hero.hndl_visible: Adversaries are collecting your encrypted data right now, storing it until quantum computers can break today's encryption. Every TLS session, VPN tunnel, and database backup crossing a public network is being harvested. The migration window closes around 2035 — but the first regulatory deadlines hit January 2027. Every month of delay is more data permanently exposed.

whyus.heading: Why Q-Readiness? Why Now?
whyus.subtitle: Four global regulatory deadlines are converging. Organizations that wait will face rushed migrations, compliance penalties, and audit failures. Q-Readiness gives you the open-source tooling and AI analysis to act now — on your terms, in your environment.
whyus.deadline2_name: EU DORA & NIS2 — Financial & critical infrastructure
whyus.deadline3_name: NIST Deprecation — RSA & ECDSA no longer approved
whyus.deadline4_name: NIST Removal — Classical algorithms disallowed entirely
whyus.col1_desc: Every scanner is inspectable on GitHub. No proprietary binaries, no vendor lock-in. You can verify exactly what runs on your infrastructure — or run it yourself.
whyus.col2_desc: Scans execute locally. Nothing phones home. Before any upload, our AI shows you exactly what it found and asks for your explicit approval. Air-gapped deployment available.
whyus.col3_desc: Claude Code cross-references findings across all 14 tools, flags confirmations and contradictions, and explains every conclusion. Board-ready, auditor-ready analysis — not a black-box score.

bom.heading: Generate Your Cryptographic BOM
bom.subtitle: Five infrastructure layers. Fourteen open-source tools. One free scan per section. Your dashboard unlocks as you scan.
bom.network_desc: Scans TLS ciphers, SSH host keys, VPN tunnels, and network handshakes for quantum-vulnerable encryption.
bom.code_desc: Scans source code dependencies, third-party libraries, and container images for weak hashing and signing algorithms.
bom.infra_desc: Scans cloud IAM roles, KMS keys, hardware security modules, and firmware signatures.
bom.data_desc: Scans databases, object storage, and backup archives for data-at-rest encryption standards.
bom.pki_desc: Scans certificate authorities, intermediate certs, OCSP responders, and key rotation policies.

howitworks.step3_desc: Get your interactive dashboard with gap analysis against 4 global standards plus tailored intelligence updates.

tiers.heading: How We Deliver
tiers.subtitle: Five delivery methods, one result: a complete quantum readiness assessment with live dashboard. Every tier uses the same 12 open-source, auditable scanners. You choose the level of automation and support. Scope is fully customizable.
tiers.traditional_desc: Manual scoping · spreadsheet inventory · vendor interviews · report writing · multiple revision cycles
tiers.qreadiness_desc: AI-driven scoping · 12 automated scanners · instant dashboard · single review cycle · auditable toolchain
tiers.tier0_desc: Run all 12 tools independently — no AI assistance. Send results for backend processing and dashboard generation. More processing time required.
tiers.tier1_desc: Claude Code guides your team through every step. Tools are open-source and auditable. Repeatable, fast, and transparent. No black boxes.
tiers.tier2_desc: For environments where AI access is restricted. We provide secure, isolated AI compute — same automation, your perimeter.
tiers.tier3_desc: We come to you. An expert deploys on your infrastructure, runs all scans, and trains your team. Travel and time included.
tiers.tier4_desc: Air-gapped AI assessment device. No network interface — physically verified. Runs all scans locally. You keep the hardware.
tiers.note: All tiers include the same deliverables: cryptographic exposure map, prioritized remediation backlog, executive risk memo, 90-day implementation plan, and access to your live Q-Readiness dashboard. Scope is always customizable: add scans for deeper coverage, remove scans to fit your environment. NIST-aligned, CNSA 2.0 compliant. Every tool is open-source and auditable on GitHub.
